description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag `ShopProductRelationshipTag` that retrieves and displays product relationships for a store, utilizing caching and dependency injection. It interacts with services to get related products, populates their data for presentation, and manages cache keys based on store and language context.

classes.name: ShopProductRelationshipTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class for retrieving related products for a store, with caching support, used in rendering product relationship groups on web pages.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Initializes dependencies if needed, retrieves related products from cache or service, and sets them in request scope based on group name.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the custom tag processing; returns evaluation directive.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches related products from the database, wraps them into readable product objects for display.
